mainEntity.name: How much does a bump-out addition typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bump-out addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, materials, and the room it's extending. For instance, extending a kitchen might require more expensive plumbing or electrical work compared to expanding a closet. Generally, you can expect costs to be lower than a full room addition, but higher than simple interior renovations. Our project managers at Hometelligent Inc. can provide a detailed estimate after assessing your specific needs and site conditions within our service areas like Pleasanton or San Leandro.
